page_title: MON 1-1 UDI | Monza v Udinese 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Today's referee Alessandro Prontera rightly decides to book Matteo Pessina (Monza) for his harsh tackle.
90+4' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) fails to deliver a decent free kick and the ball goes out of play.
90+3' Dany Mota (Monza) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

90+3' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monza.
90+3' Monza quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Monza.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90' Valentin Carboni (Monza) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Silvestri thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
88' Monza can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Valentin Carboni (Monza) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Monza will take a corner.
87' The foul by Joao Ferreira (Udinese) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alessandro Prontera.
86' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is replaced by Valentin Carboni.
83' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.

83' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Marco Silvestri thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Monza have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
82' Udinese fail to score from a corner as Michele Di Gregorio (Monza) leaps to collect the ball.
80' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Andrea Colpani and he is replaced by Samuele Birindelli (Monza).
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mirko Maric (Monza) for Lorenzo Colombo.
79' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
77' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
76' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
76' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andrea Colpani (Monza). Monza have a corner.
74' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

74' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Udinese win a corner kick.
73' Dangerous play by Warren Bondo (Monza). Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for a foul.
66' 1 - 1 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) finds the back of the net and gets on the scoresheet.
64' Andrea Colpani (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Silvestri comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' The referee signals a substitution. Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Jordan Zemura.
62' Substitution. Martin Payero walks off the pitch and Sandi Lovric (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
62' Martin Payero (Udinese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dany Mota (Monza) replacing Samuele Vignato.
60' That's the end of the game for Pablo Mari, who is replaced by Warren Bondo (Monza).
60' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Andrea Colpani (Monza), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
59' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
55' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Festy Ebosele will be replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) replaces Lazar Samardzic.
53' Wonderful movement by Monza. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monza comes to nothing.
46' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Matteo Pessina (Monza) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
45+2' Although Daniele Padelli (Udinese) is just on the bench, Alessandro Prontera has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
41' The linesman signals that Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
40' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
39' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts the ball.
36' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Pablo Mari (Monza) sees a yellow card from Alessandro Prontera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
33' Samuele Vignato (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
32' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

27' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrea Colpani (Monza) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Georgios Kyriakopoulos inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
26' Isaac Success (Udinese) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alessandro Prontera who sees an offensive foul.

23' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
22' Andrea Carboni (Monza) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
21' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
17' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
13' Samuele Vignato (Monza) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Marco Silvestri easily deals with the threat.
13' Matteo Pessina (Monza) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Udinese.
11' The ball is cleared after Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
9' Andrea Colpani (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Monza are awarded a corner kick.
8' Andrea Colpani (Monza) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

7' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The linesman makes the right call and Monza will have a corner.
6' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Alessandro Prontera is the one to supervise the game today.
